thread:
sam_ae: looping you all in — NewCorp POC kickoff tomorrow. they asked for SSO + SCIM + per-team RBAC and want an estimated blowout on cost for a 3-week pilot. can we confirm efforts and any enterprise blockers?

meera_se: thanks — quick notes: NewCorp uses on-prem Okta with SAML 2.0, user provisioning via SCIM 2.0 (token auth), and they expect role claims from SAML assertion.

carlos_se: what do they mean by "per-team RBAC"? scoped roles inside a single org or separate tenants?

sam_ae: single tenant, multiple teams. they want TeamAdmin / TeamMember / ReadOnly roles mapped from Okta groups. also domain verification: they want to lock to their corp domains so external signups blocked.

meera_se: doable. implementation plan: 1) SAML integration (IDP-initiated + SP metadata exchange) 2) SCIM endpoint for provisioning 3) group->role mapping config in the Console 4) domain allowlist and org-level enforcement. estimate 2 engineer-days for config + 2 days for test harness and docs.

tina_sec: security check: they asked about SCIM token rotation, audit logs retention (90 days), and whether SCIM traffic can be pinned to our Dedicated or Private deployment for data residency. Need to know which deployment they expect.

sam_ae: they prefer Dedicated if we can guarantee data isolation, otherwise Private. also they need SOC2 + ISO27001 docs and a short PCI callout (they're not PCI-scoped but asked anyway).

chris_prod: For Dedicated we can provide tenant isolation + IP allowlist. Private (VPC) supports customer KMS for encryption-at-rest. Template answers for questionnaires: we have SOC2 report + ISO certs, KMS integrations doc, and SCIM contract language — I can paste boilerplate.

meera_se: SCIM details: endpoint expects Authorization: Bearer <token>. sample provisioning payload:```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jane@newcorp.com",
  "externalId": "okta-12345",
  "name": {"givenName": "Jane", "familyName": "Doe"},
  "groups": ["eng-team-alpha"]
}```
map Okta groups to roles via the Console mapping UI or API.

carlos_se: Pricing question from buyer: pilot 3 weeks ~ up to 200k tokens/day during tests, plus 50 concurrent safety-check calls. any rough $/token for hosted vs dedicated for pilot?

meera_se: rough guidance: hosted API pilot rate ~ $0.0006/token (example), Dedicated reserved capacity reduces unit cost ~30% depending on committed GPU hours. for short pilot we usually recommend Hosted + burst to Dedicated if needed. will confirm with finance.

tina_sec: blocker: legal asked if SCIM provisioning changes create permanent deletes or soft-deletes only. we should confirm our default behavior and provide rollback guidance.

chris_prod: default SCIM delete is a hard delete for Users after 30-day grace when enabled; we can toggle to soft-delete flag for POC. we'll document restore steps.

sam_ae: can someone assemble a 1-page POC runbook (SAML metadata, SCIM token, role mapping steps, test users, rollback) and a pilot cost estimate (hosted vs dedicated) by EOD?

meera_se: I can do the runbook. ccing deploy-bot to show any infra tickets. @deploy-bot can we open a POC env ticket for NewCorp (dedicated trial) with team-owner meera_se?

deploy-bot: ticket #POC-7891 created — env type: dedicated-trial, owner: meera_se, expires: 2026-04-14.

tina_sec: I'll draft the security section for the questionnaire and include KMS / audit / token rotation notes.

carlos_se: I'll handle pricing/finance ask and ping Legal for SCIM delete clause.

sam_ae: awesome — meeting at 10am PT tomorrow. thanks all :rocket:
